messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning to publish Python + TS SDKs tonight during the 00:30–02:30 UTC change window. Goal: canary -> beta -> stable. Need checklist signoff and pin strategy for the old sync client deprecation. Anyone on call?

Diego: I can be on call. Canary should be scoped to clients only (py + ts). No backend infra changes.

Kai: Proposal: pin legacy sync client (sync-client) to 1.4.x for npm/pypi consumers so auto-updates don't jump to the new async-first major. We should publish the new clients under new package names or with major bump and deprecate the old.

Ava: Changelog draft (short):
```
- feat: add async-first SDKs (py 2.0.0b1, ts 2.0.0-beta)
- fix: preserve previous sync API under `sync-client` alias
- docs: deprecation notice for sync-client (sunset in 90 days)
```
Also prepared publish commands: `npm publish --tag beta` and `python -m build && twine upload --repository testpypi dist/* --skip-existing` for canaries.

Maya: Nice. Ops checklist so we all align:
- preflight: run smoke tests (unit + basic e2e) on canary
- telemetry: enable canary tag in traces and set error/cost alerts
- pin: push package pin for enterprise customers on Dedicated
- notify: create deprecation email + console banner
- rollback: exact revert commands in thread
Can someone take preflight?

Sofie: I'll run the smoke e2e and monitor metrics. Rollback plan: if error rate >5% or latency P95 increases >30% for >10m, revert clients and republish previous stable. Revert commands: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.3 latest` and `twine upload --repository pypi dist/redwood_sdk-1.9.3.tar.gz` (we'll keep the tarballs).

release-bot: publish job queued: `job/rel-py-ts-1869009999` — will start canary push in 10m. Logs will post here.

Maya: Make sure deploy-bot posts the canary manifest and the beta tag step is manual approval. We don't want automatic promotion.

deploy-bot: Canary publish started for packages: redwood-sdk (py), @redwood/sdk (ts). CI run: build, unit, smoke-e2e. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/1869009999

Diego: Reminder to add `X-Client-Deprecation` header to SDK responses and console banner for the sync client so users get a clear in-product notice. Also update the compatibility matrix in the README.

Ava: Also adding deprecation note to pypi metadata: `project_urls` -> Deprecation guide. Will patch docs site after canary looks good.

Sofie: Smoke tests are green on canary stage. No obvious regressions in basic flows. Monitoring dashboard link: https://metrics.internal/d/clients/canary-1869009999

Maya: If the next 30m stays stable, we'll tag beta and publish to the beta dist-tag (npm) / pypi pre-release. Manual approval needed from @Maya or @Diego.

Diego: Approved to tag beta if no alerts. I'll watch the dashboard. :eyes: :thumbsup:

release-bot: Canary completed. Artifacts: `redwood_sdk-2.0.0b1.tar.gz`, `@redwood/sdk-2.0.0-beta.tgz`.

Maya: OK going to promote to beta now. Reminder to keep pin for legacy sync-client in pinned-config for enterprise customers (separate PR).

Kai: After beta publishes, we should coordinate a short blog + release notes + a deprecation FAQ. I'll pick up the FAQ and enterprise pin PR.

Sofie: Beta monitoring started. Setting short TTL for code-path sampling to compare traces between stable and beta.

Maya: Final: deprecation messaging + docs PRs are required before stable. Let's hold stable promotion for 48h unless immediate unblocking. Thanks team. :shipit:
